messages:
Riya (Sales): heads up — PolarisHealth wants to run a month-long tech evaluation but procurement needs a short "POC orderform" and legal wants DPA/Dedicated SLA clarifications. They asked if we can do net-30 on a one-month trial order.
Tom (Legal): net-30 for a trial is unusual but doable if Finance signs off. We'll need to limit exposure — suggest a $10k cap and require countersign within 3 business days.
Maya (Finance): cap makes sense. Net-30 ok for 1-month POC if we set the invoice schedule to invoice at term start and include a pre-authorized payment method on file.
Sam (Solutions): clarifying — they want Dedicated but may be happy with Hosted for the POC. If Dedicated, KMS BYO is available; Hosted requires vendor-managed keys. Priya, any concerns on attestation?
Priya (Security): if Dedicated + BYO-KMS, we can provide HSM attestation. For Hosted, we can provide SOC2 + encryption-at-rest docs. We'll need the environment choice confirmed since the DPA text differs.
redwood-bot: infra-note: us-east-1 dedicated-4xA100 pool currently constrained; expected capacity in 10 days.
Riya (Sales): I'll ask which environment they want. procurement also asked for the orderform to list SLA (p95 latency), escalation contact, and the PO number.
Tom (Legal): I'll prepare a DPA redline that includes a one-page HSM attestation appendix and a 3-business-day countersign requirement. Also will mark subprocessors clause to require notice and an opt-out for non-essential subprocessors.
Maya (Finance): please include invoice terms explicitly: amount cap, net-30, invoice at start, and payment method.
Sam (Solutions): I'll assemble a 1-page "POC BOM" with GPU hours, monitoring credits, expected throughput, and fallback model options. Good to keep procurement happy.
Riya (Sales): sounds good. action items: Tom to redline DPA + HSM addendum; Maya to confirm net-30 and cap; Sam to draft POC BOM; Priya to provide attestation docs once environment confirmed.
Riya (Sales): also need a signature routing plan — they prefer DocuSign to procurement@polarishealth.gov and legal@polarishealth.gov. I'll request signer names and circulate.
Tom (Legal): will upload a DPA draft in the portal and tag this thread.
Maya (Finance): will approve net-30 cap after PO copy posted.
Priya (Security): will attach attestations after Riya confirms Dedicated vs Hosted.
Riya (Sales): closing for now, will follow up when procurement responds. :thumbsup:
